title: Auto-output
subtitle: Push outputs into the next block
text:
Use a screwdriver (without sneaking) on a side of a built machine to make it push its outputs into whatever is on that side, such as a chest or a cupboard.

Sides that output or have a pipe on them show a port. All sides are off to start with.
caption: Machine pushing into a chest

steps.title: Set an output side
steps.text: Use the screwdriver on the side facing the chest. Use it again to turn that side off.
Hoppers and other mods see the same sides: inputs can be filled, outputs emptied.
